problemStatement.formal: HasDerivAt (fun r => π * r ^ 2) (2 * π * r) r
problemStatement.plain: Prove that the circumference formula C = 2πr can be derived by differentiating the area formula A = πr² with respect to radius.
whyMatters: Formalizes the deep area-circumference duality: dA/dr = C
Extends Wiedijk #9 (Area of a Circle) with the circumference connection
Generalizes to higher dimensions: surface area = d(volume)/dr

proven: HasDerivAt areaFn (circumferenceFn r) r - area derivative equals circumference
deriv areaFn r = circumferenceFn r - deriv form of the duality
Differentiable ℝ areaFn - area function is everywhere differentiable
(volume (ball 0 r)).toReal = areaFn r - measure theory connection
Quadratic scaling of disk area under radius scaling
circumferenceFn r = 2 * π * r - circumference formula
deriv (deriv areaFn) r = 2 * π - second derivative is constant
Monotonicity of area function for non-negative radii
areaFn r = 0 ↔ r = 0 - area zero iff radius zero

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETE: 13 theorems proved with 0 sorries. Formalized circumference C=2πr as derivative of area A=πr², connected to Lebesgue measure via ENNReal.toReal, proved second derivative is 2π, monotonicity, and scaling properties.
builtItems: areaFn: ℝ → ℝ defined as π * r²
area_hasDerivAt: core theorem that dA/dr = C
measure_disk_eq_areaFn: connects calculus to measure theory
insights: HasDerivAt for π*r² works cleanly via hasDerivAt_pow + const_mul
ENNReal.toReal_mul + ENNReal.toReal_pow + ENNReal.toReal_ofReal chain handles measure→real conversion
nlinarith with sq_nonneg handles monotonicity of r² when pow_le_pow_left is unavailable
The area-circumference duality generalizes: in n dimensions, d(V_n)/dr = S_{n-1}
mathlibGaps: pow_le_pow_left not available in Mathlib v4.26.0 (renamed or removed)
ENNReal.toReal_coe and ENNReal.toReal_coe_nnreal not available - use NNReal.coe_real_pi directly
nextSteps: Could extend to prove area as integral of circumference: A(r) = ∫₀ʳ 2πρ dρ
Could generalize to n-dimensional balls: d(V_n)/dr = S_{n-1}
Submit to Aristotle for potential proof improvements

approaches.name: Direct calculus with HasDerivAt
approaches.description: Define areaFn(r) = πr² and circumferenceFn(r) = 2πr, prove HasDerivAt areaFn (circumferenceFn r) r using hasDerivAt_pow and const_mul. Connect to measure theory via ENNReal.toReal.
